--- file: app/Admin/Index.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Index

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin" { } requires user, role Admin

-- A card of the dashboard: a table's count and its newest rows, each linking to its page.
type Card = { key: Text, title: Text, href: Page, count: Int, rows: List { label: Text, href: Page } }

type Model = { cards: List Card }

-- recent is how many of a table's newest rows its card lists.
recent : Int
recent = 5

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin cards
    let todos <- Db.from Todo |> Db.orderBy Todo.created.desc |> Db.limit recent |> Db.all
    let todoCount <- Db.from Todo |> Db.count
    let users <- Db.from User |> Db.orderBy User.created.desc |> Db.limit recent |> Db.all
    let userCount <- Db.from User |> Db.count
    Query.succeed { cards: [
      {
        key: "todos",
        title: "Todos",
        href: Admin.Todo.Index {},
        count: todoCount,
        rows: List.map (\row -> { label: row.title, href: Admin.Todo.Show { id: row.id } }) todos,
      },
      {
        key: "users",
        title: "Users",
        href: Admin.User.Index {},
        count: userCount,
        rows: List.map (\row -> { label: row.email, href: Admin.User.Show { id: row.id } }) users,
      },
    ] }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Dashboard">
    <h1>Admin</h1>

    <al-stack gap="md">
      {for card in model.cards ->
        <al-card id={card.key}>
          <h2 slot="header"><a href={card.href}>{card.title}</a> <al-badge variant="secondary">{Text.fromInt card.count}</al-badge></h2>
          <ul>
            {for row in card.rows -> <li><a href={row.href}>{row.label}</a></li>}
          </ul>
        </al-card>}
    </al-stack>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests
test "the dashboard counts the todos and lists the newest five" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\n -> Db.insert Todo {
    title: Text.NonEmpty ("title-" ++ Text.fromInt n),
    due: Nothing,
    owner: me,
  }) (List.range 1 6))
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Index {})
  Task.succeed ({
    count: Test.text "#todos al-badge" page.doc,
    rows: Test.texts "#todos li" page.doc,
  } == {
    count: Just "6",
    rows: ["title-6", "title-5", "title-4", "title-3", "title-2"],
  })
}

test "the dashboard counts the users and lists the newest five" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\n -> Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email ("email-" ++ Text.fromInt n ++ "@example.com"),
    name: Text.NonEmpty ("name-" ++ Text.fromInt n),
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-" ++ Text.fromInt n,
  }) (List.range 2 7))
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Index {})
  Task.succeed ({
    count: Test.text "#users al-badge" page.doc,
    rows: Test.texts "#users li" page.doc,
  } == {
    count: Just "7",
    rows: [
      "email-7@example.com",
      "email-6@example.com",
      "email-5@example.com",
      "email-4@example.com",
      "email-3@example.com",
    ],
  })
}

test "a visitor is sent to log in" = {
  let r <- Test.open (Admin.Index {})
  Task.succeed (r.answer == Redirected (Auth.Login {}))
}

test "a Member gets no page, even one made Admin since logging in" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Member }
  let r <- Test.open (Admin.Index {})
  Task.succeed (r.answer == PageMissing)
}

test "a demoted Admin is refused at once" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Member,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let r <- Test.open (Admin.Index {})
  Task.succeed (r.answer == PageMissing)
}
-- @admin end

--- file: app/Admin/Layout.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Layout

-- @admin begin imports
import Layout
import User
-- @admin end

-- The admin's frame: the app's layout around a nav of every table's list.
Page : { title: Text, children: List (Html a) } -> Html a
Page props =
  <Layout.Page title={props.title ++ " · Admin"}>
    <nav aria-label="Admin">
      <al-stack direction="row" gap="sm">
        <a href={Admin.Index {}}>Dashboard</a>
        -- @admin begin nav
        <a href={Admin.Todo.Index {}}>Todos</a>
        <a href={Admin.User.Index {}}>Users</a>
        -- @admin end
      </al-stack>
    </nav>
    {props.children}
  </Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin access
-- isAdmin is whether the signed-in user may use the admin, which every page's load asks (it runs
-- before every message too). The session's role is the one read at login, and lasts until
-- logout or the cookie's 30 days (chapter 6, "Rules"): the user table holds the role, so it is
-- read again, and a user demoted or deleted since gets a 404 at once.
isAdmin : User.UserId -> Query Bool
isAdmin id = {
  let me <- Db.get User id
  Query.succeed (Maybe.map (\u -> u.role) me == Just Admin)
}
-- @admin end

--- file: app/Admin/Todo/Bulk.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.Bulk

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/todo/bulk" { ids: List Todo.TodoId } requires user, role Admin

-- The rows chosen on the list, and the ids of those that other rows keep from being deleted.
type Model = { rows: List Todo, held: List Todo.TodoId }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let rows <- Db.from Todo |> Db.where (Todo.id.in params.ids) |> Db.all
    Query.succeed { rows: rows, held: [] }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- refused says whether a row is kept from being deleted: rows refer to it with a `@restrict`.
refused : Model -> Session -> Todo -> Bool
refused model session row = List.member row.id model.held

-- @admin begin bulk
form Confirm = { }

msg BulkDelete form Confirm

form SetDone = { value: Bool }

msg BulkSetDone form SetDone

-- Each action reads the rows again (load runs before every message) and goes back to the list.
update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  BulkDelete p -> {
    let allowed = List.filter (\row -> refused model session row == False) model.rows
    let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\row -> Db.delete Todo row.id) allowed)
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Index {}))
  },
  BulkSetDone p -> {
    let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\row -> Db.update Todo row.id (\r -> { r | done: p.form.value })) model.rows)
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Index {}))
  },
}
-- @admin end

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Selected todos">
    <h1>{Text.fromInt (List.length model.rows)} selected</h1>

    <al-card>
      <ul id="selected">
        {for row in model.rows ->
          <li>{row.title}{if refused model session row then <small> (kept: other rows refer to it)</small> else <span></span>}</li>}
      </ul>
      -- @admin begin actions
      <form id="bulk-delete" submit={BulkDelete}>
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        <al-button variant="destructive" type="submit">Delete the rows that can be deleted</al-button>
      </form>
      <form id="set-done" submit={BulkSetDone}>
        <al-checkbox field="value" label="Done" />
        <al-button type="submit">Set done</al-button>
      </form>
      -- @admin end
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.Todo.Index {}}>Back to the list</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests
test "deleting the chosen rows" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let todo1 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let todo2 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-2", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.Bulk { ids: [todo1] })
  let r <- Test.submit Confirm { }
  let gone <- Db.get Todo todo1
  let left <- Db.get Todo todo2
  Task.succeed ({
    answer: r.answer,
    gone: Maybe.map (\row -> row.id) gone,
    left: Maybe.map (\row -> row.id) left,
  } == {
    answer: Redirected (Admin.Todo.Index {}),
    gone: Nothing,
    left: Just todo2,
  })
}

test "setting done changes the chosen rows only" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let todo1 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let todo2 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-2", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.Bulk { ids: [todo1] })
  let r <- Test.submit SetDone { value: True }
  let one <- Db.get Todo todo1
  let other <- Db.get Todo todo2
  Task.succeed ({
    answer: r.answer,
    one: Maybe.map (\row -> row.done == True) one,
    other: Maybe.map (\row -> row.done == True) other,
  } == {
    answer: Redirected (Admin.Todo.Index {}),
    one: Just True,
    other: Just False,
  })
}

  let me <- Db.insert User {

-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.Delete

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/todo/{id}/delete" { id: Todo.TodoId } requires user, role Admin

-- The row, and how many rows of each table refer to it.
type Model = {
  row: Todo,
  -- @admin begin model
  -- @admin end
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let found <- Db.get Todo params.id
    match found {
      Just row -> Query.succeed { row: row },
      Nothing -> Query.notFound,
    }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin blockers
-- blockers counts the rows that keep this one from being deleted, which the database would
-- refuse the delete for: the `@restrict` references to it, or to a row deleted with it.
blockers : Model -> Int
blockers model = 0
-- @admin end

-- Delete takes no input: the form is the button, and the place a refusal is shown.
form Confirm = { }

msg Remove form Confirm

-- Remove deletes the row, unless rows refer to it that keep it (load counted them, as it does
-- before every message): the database would refuse the delete with an error, and the page says
-- why instead.
update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Remove p -> {
    -- @admin begin remove
    let _ <- Db.delete Todo model.row.id
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Index {}))
    -- @admin end
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Delete todo">
    <h1>Delete this todo?</h1>

    <al-card>
      -- @admin begin row
      <p>{model.row.title}</p>
      -- @admin end
      <dl>
        -- @admin begin counts
        -- @admin end
      </dl>
      <form id="delete" submit={Remove}>
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        {if blockers model > 0 then <p>It cannot be deleted while other rows refer to it.</p> else <al-button variant="destructive" type="submit">Delete</al-button>}
      </form>
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.Todo.Show { id: model.row.id }}>Back</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

--- file: app/Admin/Todo/Edit.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.Edit

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/todo/{id}/edit" { id: Todo.TodoId, findOwner: Text = "" } requires user, role Admin

type Model = {
  row: Todo,
  -- @admin begin model
  owners: List User,
  ownersTotal: Int,
  -- @admin end
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let found <- Db.get Todo params.id
    match found {
      Just row -> {
        let findOwner = Text.slice 0 200 params.findOwner
        let ownersTotal <- Db.from User |> Db.count
        let owners <- Db.from User |> Db.orderBy User.email.asc |> Db.where (if ownersTotal > 200 then Db.or [
          User.email.contains findOwner,
          User.id.eq row.owner,
        ] else Db.and []) |> Db.limit (if ownersTotal > 200 then 50 else 200) |> Db.all
        Query.succeed { row: row, owners: owners, ownersTotal: ownersTotal }
      },
      Nothing -> Query.notFound,
    }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin form
form TodoForm = {
  title: Text.NonEmpty,
  done: Bool,
  due: Maybe Date,
  owner: User.UserId,
}
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin search
form FindOwner = { q: Text }

msg SearchOwner form FindOwner

-- @admin end

msg Save form TodoForm

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  -- @admin begin finds
  SearchOwner p -> Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Edit { id: model.row.id, findOwner: p.form.q })),
  -- @admin end
  Save p -> {
    -- @admin begin update
    let _ <- Db.update Todo model.row.id (\row -> { row |
      title: p.form.title,
      done: p.form.done,
      due: p.form.due,
      owner: p.form.owner,
    })
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Show { id: model.row.id }))
    -- @admin end
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Edit todo">
    <h1>Edit todo</h1>

    <al-card>
      -- @admin begin finder
      {if model.ownersTotal > 200 then <form submit={SearchOwner}><al-input field="q" label="Find owner" /><al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Find</al-button></form> else <span></span>}
      -- @admin end
      <form submit={Save}>
        -- @admin begin inputs
        <al-input field="title" label="Title" value={model.row.title} />
        <al-checkbox field="done" label="Done" value={model.row.done} />
        <al-input field="due" label="Due" value={model.row.due} />
        <al-select field="owner" label="Owner" options={List.map (\r -> { value: r.id, label: r.email }) model.owners} value={model.row.owner} />
        -- @admin end
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        <al-button type="submit">Save</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.Todo.Show { id: model.row.id }}>Back</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests
test "saving changes every field" = {
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let todo1 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let user2 <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-2@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-2",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-2",
  }
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.Edit { id: todo1 })
  let r <- Test.submit TodoForm {
    title: Text.NonEmpty "title-2",
    done: True,
    due: Just today,
    owner: user2,
  }
  let after <- Db.get Todo todo1
  Task.succeed ({
    answer: r.answer,
    row: Maybe.map (\row -> {
      title: row.title,
      done: row.done,
      due: row.due,
      owner: row.owner,
    }) after,
    owners: Test.texts "select[name=owner] option" page.doc,
  } == {
    answer: Redirected (Admin.Todo.Show { id: todo1 }),
    row: Just { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-2", done: True, due: Just today, owner: user2 },
    owners: ["email-1@example.com", "email-2@example.com"],
  })
}

test "an owner not offered is refused" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let todo1 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let user2 <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-2@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-2",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-2",
  }
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.Edit { id: todo1 })
  let r <- Test.submitRaw TodoForm [
    { name: "title", value: "x" },
    { name: "done", value: "True" },
    { name: "due", value: "" },
    { name: "owner", value: "missing" },
  ]
  let after <- Db.get Todo todo1
  Task.succeed ({
    answer: r.answer,
    owner: Maybe.map (\row -> row.owner) after,
  } == {
    answer: FormRejected [{ field: "owner", message: "must be one of the options" }],
    owner: Just me,
  })
}

test "a list of 200 users is offered whole" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let todo1 <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let user2 <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-2@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-2",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-2",
  }
  let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\n -> Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email ("email-" ++ Text.fromInt n ++ "@example.com"),
    name: Text.NonEmpty ("name-" ++ Text.fromInt n),
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-" ++ Text.fromInt n,
  }) (List.range 3 200))
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.Edit { id: todo1 })
  Task.succeed (List.length page.model.owners == 200)
}

--- file: app/Admin/Todo/Index.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.Index

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin params
page "/admin/todo" {
  q: Text = "",
  done: Text = "",
  sort: Text = "created",
  dir: Text = "desc",
  page: Int = 1,
} requires user, role Admin
-- @admin end

type Model = {
  rows: List Todo,
  labels: Labels,
  q: Text,
  filters: Filters,
  sort: Text,
  dir: Text,
  page: Int,
  pages: Int,
  count: Int,
}

perPage : Int
perPage = 25

-- @admin begin search
-- search is the rows whose text contains q (every row for "").
search : Text -> Condition Todo
search q = Db.or [Todo.title.contains q]
-- @admin end

-- A Filter is one of the list's selects: the column it filters, the option chosen ("" for any),
-- and each option's value in the address, its label, and the rows it selects.
type Filter = {
  name: Text,
  label: Text,
  value: Text,
  options: List { value: Text, label: Text, rows: Condition Todo },
}

-- @admin begin filters
-- Filters are the option each filter has chosen in the address ("" for any): a select for each
-- Bool and union column.
type Filters = { done: Text }

-- chosen is the filters' options in params.
chosen : Params -> Filters
chosen params = { done: params.done }

-- filters are the list's filters, each with the option f has chosen.
filters : Filters -> List Filter
filters f = [
  { name: "done", label: "Done", value: f.done, options: [
    { value: "yes", label: "yes", rows: Todo.done.eq True },
    { value: "no", label: "no", rows: Todo.done.eq False },
  ] },
]

-- filtered is the rows that the option each filter has chosen selects (every row for "", or for
-- a value that is no option's).
filtered : List Filter -> Condition Todo
filtered fs = Db.and (List.map (\f -> match List.find (\o -> o.value == f.value) f.options {
  Just o -> o.rows,
  Nothing -> Db.and [],
}) fs)

-- listAt is this list with the model's search and filters, sorted by sort and dir, at page n.
listAt : Model -> Text -> Text -> Int -> Page
listAt model sort dir n = Admin.Todo.Index {
  q: model.q,
  done: model.filters.done,
  sort: sort,
  dir: dir,
  page: n,
}
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin sorts
-- sorts are the columns the list sorts by, by name.
sorts : List { name: Text, asc: Order Todo, desc: Order Todo }
sorts = [
  { name: "title", asc: Todo.title.asc, desc: Todo.title.desc },
  { name: "done", asc: Todo.done.asc, desc: Todo.done.desc },
  { name: "due", asc: Todo.due.asc, desc: Todo.due.desc },
  { name: "owner", asc: Todo.owner.asc, desc: Todo.owner.desc },
  { name: "created", asc: Todo.created.asc, desc: Todo.created.desc },
]
-- @admin end

-- order is the ordering sort names, ascending when dir is "asc"; a name that is not a column's
-- sorts newest first.
order : Text -> Text -> Order Todo
order sort dir = match List.find (\s -> s.name == sort) sorts {
  Just s -> if dir == "asc" then s.asc else s.desc,
  Nothing -> Todo.created.desc,
}

-- toggle is the direction a column's header sorts by: the other way round when the list is
-- sorted by that column ascending.
toggle : Model -> Text -> Text
toggle model sort = if model.sort == sort && model.dir == "asc" then "desc" else "asc"

-- load reads how many rows match the search and the filters, and one page of them (the last, for
-- a page past it), in the order asked for. The search text is cut to 200 characters (Text.slice):
-- a text over 10,000 bytes would fail the query (chapter 8, "Search").
load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    let q = Text.slice 0 200 params.q
    let f = chosen params
    let count <- Db.from Todo |> Db.where (Db.and [search q, filtered (filters f)]) |> Db.count
    let pages = Int.max 1 ((count + perPage - 1) / perPage)
    let page = Int.clamp { min: 1, max: pages } params.page
    let rows <-
      Db.from Todo
        |> Db.where (Db.and [search q, filtered (filters f)])
        |> Db.orderBy (order params.sort params.dir)
        |> Db.limit perPage
        |> Db.offset ((page - 1) * perPage)
        |> Db.all
    let labels <- labelsOf rows
    Query.succeed {
      rows: rows,
      labels: labels,
      q: q,
      filters: f,
      sort: params.sort,
      dir: params.dir,
      page: page,
      pages: pages,
      count: count,
    }
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin labels
-- Labels are the rows the references of the rows shown name: their links show their labels.
type Labels = { owners: List User }

-- labelsOf reads the rows that rows refer to.
labelsOf : List Todo -> Query Labels
labelsOf rows = {
  let owners <- Db.from User |> Db.where (User.id.in (List.map (\row -> row.owner) rows)) |> Db.all
  Query.succeed { owners: owners }
}

-- ownerLabel is the label of the user id names (the id itself if it names none).
ownerLabel : Labels -> User.UserId -> Text
ownerLabel labels id = match List.find (\r -> r.id == id) labels.owners {
  Just r -> r.email,
  Nothing -> id,
}
-- @admin end

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Todos">
    <h1>Todos</h1>

    <al-stack direction="row" gap="sm">
      <form method="get" action="/admin/todo">
        <input type="search" name="q" value={model.q} aria-label="Search" />
        {for f in filters model.filters ->
          <al-select label={f.label}>
            <label>{f.label}
              <select name={f.name}>
                <option value="" selected={f.value == ""}>any</option>
                {for o in f.options -> <option value={o.value} selected={o.value == f.value}>{o.label}</option>}
              </select>
            </label>
          </al-select>}
        <input type="hidden" name="sort" value={model.sort} />
        <input type="hidden" name="dir" value={model.dir} />
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Search</al-button>
      </form>
      <al-button href={Admin.Todo.New {}}>New todo</al-button>
    </al-stack>

    <p id="count">{if model.count == 1 then "1 row" else Text.fromInt model.count ++ " rows"}</p>

    <al-table>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            -- @admin begin headers
            <th><span class="sr-only">Choose</span></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "title" (toggle model "title") 1}>Title</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "done" (toggle model "done") 1}>Done</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "due" (toggle model "due") 1}>Due</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "owner" (toggle model "owner") 1}>Owner</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "created" (toggle model "created") 1}>Created</a></th>
            -- @admin end
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {for row in model.rows ->
            <tr>
              -- @admin begin cells
              <td><input type="checkbox" name="ids" form="bulk" value={row.id} aria-label="Choose this row" /></td>
              <td><a href={Admin.Todo.Show { id: row.id }}>{row.title}</a></td>
              <td>{if row.done then <al-badge>Yes</al-badge> else <al-badge variant="secondary">No</al-badge>}</td>
              <td>{match row.due { Just v -> Date.format "Jan 2, 2006" v, Nothing -> "" }}</td>
              <td><a href={Admin.User.Show { id: row.owner }}>{ownerLabel model.labels row.owner}</a></td>
              <td>{Time.format "Jan 2, 2006" row.created}</td>
              -- @admin end
            </tr>}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </al-table>

    <al-stack direction="row" gap="sm">
      <form id="bulk" method="get" action="/admin/todo/bulk">
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Act on the chosen rows</al-button>
      </form>
      <form id="bulk-page" method="get" action="/admin/todo/bulk">
        {for row in model.rows -> <input type="hidden" name="ids" value={row.id} />}
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Act on all rows on this page</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-stack>

    <al-pagination role="navigation" aria-label="Pages">
      {if model.page > 1 then <a slot="prev" href={listAt model model.sort model.dir (model.page - 1)} rel="prev">Previous</a> else <span slot="prev" aria-disabled="true">Previous</span>}
      <span>Page {Text.fromInt model.page} of {Text.fromInt model.pages}</span>
      {if model.page < model.pages then <a slot="next" href={listAt model model.sort model.dir (model.page + 1)} rel="next">Next</a> else <span slot="next" aria-disabled="true">Next</span>}
    </al-pagination>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests

--- file: app/Admin/Todo/New.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.New

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/todo/new" { findOwner: Text = "" } requires user, role Admin

type Model = {
  -- @admin begin model
  owners: List User,
  ownersTotal: Int,
  -- @admin end
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let findOwner = Text.slice 0 200 params.findOwner
    let ownersTotal <- Db.from User |> Db.count
    let owners <- Db.from User |> Db.orderBy User.email.asc |> Db.where (if ownersTotal > 200 then User.email.contains findOwner else Db.and []) |> Db.limit (if ownersTotal > 200 then 50 else 200) |> Db.all
    Query.succeed { owners: owners, ownersTotal: ownersTotal }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin form
form TodoForm = {
  title: Text.NonEmpty,
  done: Bool,
  due: Maybe Date,
  owner: User.UserId,
}
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin search
form FindOwner = { q: Text }

msg SearchOwner form FindOwner

-- @admin end

msg Create form TodoForm

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  -- @admin begin finds
  SearchOwner p -> Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.New { findOwner: p.form.q })),
  -- @admin end
  Create p -> {
    -- @admin begin insert
    let id <- Db.insert Todo {
      title: p.form.title,
      done: p.form.done,
      due: p.form.due,
      owner: p.form.owner,
    }
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.Todo.Show { id: id }))
    -- @admin end
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="New todo">
    <h1>New todo</h1>

    <al-card>
      -- @admin begin finder
      {if model.ownersTotal > 200 then <form submit={SearchOwner}><al-input field="q" label="Find owner" /><al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Find</al-button></form> else <span></span>}
      -- @admin end
      <form submit={Create}>
        -- @admin begin inputs
        <al-input field="title" label="Title" />
        <al-checkbox field="done" label="Done" value={False} />
        <al-input field="due" label="Due" />
        <al-select field="owner" label="Owner" options={List.map (\r -> { value: r.id, label: r.email }) model.owners} />
        -- @admin end
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        <al-button type="submit">Create</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests
test "creating a todo adds it, with the values submitted" = {
  let today <- Date.today
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let user2 <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-2@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-2",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-2",
  }
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.New {})
  let r <- Test.submit TodoForm {
    title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1",
    done: True,
    due: Just today,
    owner: user2,
  }
  let rows <- Db.from Todo |> Db.all
  Task.succeed ({
    answers: List.map (\row -> Redirected (Admin.Todo.Show { id: row.id })) rows,
    rows: List.map (\row -> {
      title: row.title,
      done: row.done,
      due: row.due,
      owner: row.owner,
    }) rows,
    owners: Test.texts "select[name=owner] option" page.doc,
  } == {
    answers: [r.answer],
    rows: [{ title: Text.NonEmpty "title-1", done: True, due: Just today, owner: user2 }],
    owners: ["email-1@example.com", "email-2@example.com"],
  })
}

test "an owner not offered is refused" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-1@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-1",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-1",
    role: Admin,
  }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let user2 <- Db.insert User {
    email: Text.Email "email-2@example.com",
    name: Text.NonEmpty "name-2",
    passwordHash: "passwordhash-2",
  }
  let page <- Test.get (Admin.Todo.New {})
  let r <- Test.submitRaw TodoForm [
    { name: "title", value: "x" },
    { name: "done", value: "True" },
    { name: "due", value: "" },
    { name: "owner", value: "missing" },
  ]
  let rows <- Db.from Todo |> Db.count
  Task.succeed ({
    answer: r.answer,

-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.Todo.Show

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/todo/{id}" { id: Todo.TodoId } requires user, role Admin

type Model = { row: Todo, labels: Labels }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    let found <- Db.get Todo params.id
    match found {
      Just row -> {
        let labels <- labelsOf [row]
        Query.succeed { row: row, labels: labels }
      },
      Nothing -> Query.notFound,
    }
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin labels
-- Labels are the rows the references of the rows shown name: their links show their labels.
type Labels = { owners: List User }

-- labelsOf reads the rows that rows refer to.
labelsOf : List Todo -> Query Labels
labelsOf rows = {
  let owners <- Db.from User |> Db.where (User.id.in (List.map (\row -> row.owner) rows)) |> Db.all
  Query.succeed { owners: owners }
}

-- ownerLabel is the label of the user id names (the id itself if it names none).
ownerLabel : Labels -> User.UserId -> Text
ownerLabel labels id = match List.find (\r -> r.id == id) labels.owners {
  Just r -> r.email,
  Nothing -> id,
}
-- @admin end

-- Delete goes to the delete page, which shows what refers to the row before anything is deleted.
view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Todo">
    <h1>Todo</h1>

    <al-card>
      <dl>
        -- @admin begin fields
        <dt>Id</dt>
        <dd>{model.row.id}</dd>
        <dt>Title</dt>
        <dd>{model.row.title}</dd>
        <dt>Done</dt>
        <dd>{if model.row.done then <al-badge>Yes</al-badge> else <al-badge variant="secondary">No</al-badge>}</dd>
        <dt>Due</dt>
        <dd>{match model.row.due { Just v -> Date.format "Jan 2, 2006" v, Nothing -> "" }}</dd>
        <dt>Owner</dt>
        <dd><a href={Admin.User.Show { id: model.row.owner }}>{ownerLabel model.labels model.row.owner}</a></dd>
        <dt>Created</dt>
        <dd>{Time.format "Jan 2, 2006" model.row.created}</dd>
        -- @admin end
      </dl>
      <div slot="actions">
        <al-button href={Admin.Todo.Edit { id: model.row.id }}>Edit</al-button>
        <al-button variant="destructive" href={Admin.Todo.Delete { id: model.row.id }}>Delete</al-button>
      </div>
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.Todo.Index {}}>All todos</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

--- file: app/Admin/User/Bulk.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.User.Bulk

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/user/bulk" { ids: List User.UserId } requires user, role Admin

-- The rows chosen on the list, and the ids of those that other rows keep from being deleted.
type Model = { rows: List User, held: List User.UserId }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let rows <- Db.from User |> Db.where (User.id.in params.ids) |> Db.all
    let held1 <- Db.from Todo |> Db.where (Todo.owner.in (params.ids)) |> Db.all
    Query.succeed { rows: rows, held: List.concat [List.map (\r -> r.owner) held1] }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- refused says whether a row is kept from being deleted: rows refer to it with a `@restrict`,
-- or it is the signed-in user's own.
refused : Model -> Session -> User -> Bool
refused model session row = List.member row.id model.held || session.user == row.id

-- @admin begin bulk
form Confirm = { }

msg BulkDelete form Confirm

-- Each action reads the rows again (load runs before every message) and goes back to the list.
update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  BulkDelete p -> {
    let allowed = List.filter (\row -> refused model session row == False) model.rows
    let _ <- Task.all (List.map (\row -> Db.delete User row.id) allowed)
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.User.Index {}))
  },
}
-- @admin end

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Selected users">
    <h1>{Text.fromInt (List.length model.rows)} selected</h1>

    <al-card>
      <ul id="selected">
        {for row in model.rows ->
          <li>{row.email}{if refused model session row then <small> (kept: other rows refer to it)</small> else <span></span>}</li>}
      </ul>
      -- @admin begin actions
      <form id="bulk-delete" submit={BulkDelete}>
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        <al-button variant="destructive" type="submit">Delete the rows that can be deleted</al-button>
      </form>
      -- @admin end
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.User.Index {}}>Back to the list</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests

--- file: app/Admin/User/Delete.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.User.Delete

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import Todo
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/user/{id}/delete" { id: User.UserId } requires user, role Admin

-- The row, and how many rows of each table refer to it.
type Model = {
  row: User,
  -- @admin begin model
  own: Bool,
  todos: Int,
  -- @admin end
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let found <- Db.get User params.id
    let todos <- Db.from Todo |> Db.where (Todo.owner.eq params.id) |> Db.count
    match found {
      Just row -> Query.succeed { row: row, own: session.user == row.id, todos: todos },
      Nothing -> Query.notFound,
    }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin blockers
-- blockers counts the rows that keep this one from being deleted, which the database would
-- refuse the delete for: the `@restrict` references to it, or to a row deleted with it.
blockers : Model -> Int
blockers model = model.todos
-- @admin end

-- Delete takes no input: the form is the button, and the place a refusal is shown.
form Confirm = { }

msg Remove form Confirm

-- Remove deletes the row, unless rows refer to it that keep it (load counted them, as it does
-- before every message): the database would refuse the delete with an error, and the page says
-- why instead.
update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Remove p -> {
    -- @admin begin remove
    if model.own then
      Task.succeed (Reject "You cannot delete your own account.")
    else if blockers model > 0 then
      Task.succeed (Reject "This user cannot be deleted while other rows refer to it.")
    else {
      let _ <- Db.delete User model.row.id
      Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.User.Index {}))
    }
    -- @admin end
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Delete user">
    <h1>Delete this user?</h1>

    <al-card>
      -- @admin begin row
      <p>{model.row.email}</p>
      -- @admin end
      <dl>
        -- @admin begin counts
        <dt>Todos that keep it from being deleted</dt>
        <dd id="todos">{Text.fromInt model.todos}</dd>
        -- @admin end
      </dl>
      <form id="delete" submit={Remove}>
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        {if model.own then <p>You cannot delete your own account.</p>
          else if blockers model > 0 then <p>It cannot be deleted while other rows refer to it.</p>
          else <al-button variant="destructive" type="submit">Delete</al-button>}
      </form>
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.User.Show { id: model.row.id }}>Back</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests

-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.User.Edit

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import User
-- @admin end

page "/admin/user/{id}/edit" { id: User.UserId } requires user, role Admin

type Model = {
  row: User,
  -- @admin begin model
  -- @admin end
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    -- @admin begin load
    let found <- Db.get User params.id
    match found {
      Just row -> {
        Query.succeed { row: row }
      },
      Nothing -> Query.notFound,
    }
    -- @admin end
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin form
form UserForm = {
  email: Text.Email,
  name: Text.NonEmpty,
  role: User.Role,
}
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin search
-- @admin end

msg Save form UserForm

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  -- @admin begin finds
  -- @admin end
  Save p -> {
    -- @admin begin update
    if session.user == model.row.id && p.form.role != model.row.role then
      Task.succeed (Reject "You cannot change your own role.")
    else {
      let emailTaken <- Db.from User |> Db.where (Db.and [
        User.email.eq p.form.email,
        User.id.ne model.row.id,
      ]) |> Db.count
      if emailTaken > 0 then
        Task.succeed (Reject "A user with this email exists.")
      else {
        let _ <- Db.update User model.row.id (\row -> { row |
          email: p.form.email,
          name: p.form.name,
          role: p.form.role,
        })
        Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.User.Show { id: model.row.id }))
      }
    }
    -- @admin end
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Edit user">
    <h1>Edit user</h1>

    <al-card>
      -- @admin begin finder
      -- @admin end
      <form submit={Save}>
        -- @admin begin inputs
        <al-input field="email" label="Email" value={model.row.email} />
        <al-input field="name" label="Name" value={model.row.name} />
        <al-select field="role" label="Role" value={model.row.role} />
        -- @admin end
        <al-alert variant="destructive"><Errors form /></al-alert>
        <al-button type="submit">Save</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>
    <a href={Admin.User.Show { id: model.row.id }}>Back</a>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

--- file: app/Admin/User/Index.alder ---
-- generated by `alder new admin`; regions between
-- `-- @admin begin <name>` / `-- @admin end` are rewritten by `alder regen admin`
module Admin.User.Index

-- @admin begin imports
import Admin.Layout
import User
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin params
page "/admin/user" {
  q: Text = "",
  role: Text = "",
  sort: Text = "created",
  dir: Text = "desc",
  page: Int = 1,
} requires user, role Admin
-- @admin end

type Model = {
  rows: List User,
  labels: Labels,
  q: Text,
  filters: Filters,
  sort: Text,
  dir: Text,
  page: Int,
  pages: Int,
  count: Int,
}

perPage : Int
perPage = 25

-- @admin begin search
-- search is the rows whose text contains q (every row for "").
search : Text -> Condition User
search q = Db.or [User.email.contains q, User.name.contains q]
-- @admin end

-- A Filter is one of the list's selects: the column it filters, the option chosen ("" for any),
-- and each option's value in the address, its label, and the rows it selects.
type Filter = {
  name: Text,
  label: Text,
  value: Text,
  options: List { value: Text, label: Text, rows: Condition User },
}

-- @admin begin filters
-- Filters are the option each filter has chosen in the address ("" for any): a select for each
-- Bool and union column.
type Filters = { role: Text }

-- chosen is the filters' options in params.
chosen : Params -> Filters
chosen params = { role: params.role }

-- filters are the list's filters, each with the option f has chosen.
filters : Filters -> List Filter
filters f = [
  { name: "role", label: "Role", value: f.role, options: [
    { value: "Member", label: "Member", rows: User.role.eq Member },
    { value: "Admin", label: "Admin", rows: User.role.eq Admin },
  ] },
]

-- filtered is the rows that the option each filter has chosen selects (every row for "", or for
-- a value that is no option's).
filtered : List Filter -> Condition User
filtered fs = Db.and (List.map (\f -> match List.find (\o -> o.value == f.value) f.options {
  Just o -> o.rows,
  Nothing -> Db.and [],
}) fs)

-- listAt is this list with the model's search and filters, sorted by sort and dir, at page n.
listAt : Model -> Text -> Text -> Int -> Page
listAt model sort dir n = Admin.User.Index {
  q: model.q,
  role: model.filters.role,
  sort: sort,
  dir: dir,
  page: n,
}
-- @admin end

-- @admin begin sorts
-- sorts are the columns the list sorts by, by name.
sorts : List { name: Text, asc: Order User, desc: Order User }
sorts = [
  { name: "email", asc: User.email.asc, desc: User.email.desc },
  { name: "name", asc: User.name.asc, desc: User.name.desc },
  { name: "created", asc: User.created.asc, desc: User.created.desc },
  { name: "role", asc: User.role.asc, desc: User.role.desc },
]
-- @admin end

-- order is the ordering sort names, ascending when dir is "asc"; a name that is not a column's
-- sorts newest first.
order : Text -> Text -> Order User
order sort dir = match List.find (\s -> s.name == sort) sorts {
  Just s -> if dir == "asc" then s.asc else s.desc,
  Nothing -> User.created.desc,
}

-- toggle is the direction a column's header sorts by: the other way round when the list is
-- sorted by that column ascending.
toggle : Model -> Text -> Text
toggle model sort = if model.sort == sort && model.dir == "asc" then "desc" else "asc"

-- load reads how many rows match the search and the filters, and one page of them (the last, for
-- a page past it), in the order asked for. The search text is cut to 200 characters (Text.slice):
-- a text over 10,000 bytes would fail the query (chapter 8, "Search").
load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let admin <- Admin.Layout.isAdmin session.user
  if admin then {
    let q = Text.slice 0 200 params.q
    let f = chosen params
    let count <- Db.from User |> Db.where (Db.and [search q, filtered (filters f)]) |> Db.count
    let pages = Int.max 1 ((count + perPage - 1) / perPage)
    let page = Int.clamp { min: 1, max: pages } params.page
    let rows <-
      Db.from User
        |> Db.where (Db.and [search q, filtered (filters f)])
        |> Db.orderBy (order params.sort params.dir)
        |> Db.limit perPage
        |> Db.offset ((page - 1) * perPage)
        |> Db.all
    let labels <- labelsOf rows
    Query.succeed {
      rows: rows,
      labels: labels,
      q: q,
      filters: f,
      sort: params.sort,
      dir: params.dir,
      page: page,
      pages: pages,
      count: count,
    }
  } else Query.notFound
}

-- @admin begin labels
-- Labels are the rows the references of the rows shown name: their links show their labels.
type Labels = { }

labelsOf : List User -> Query Labels
labelsOf rows = Query.succeed { }
-- @admin end

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Admin.Layout.Page title="Users">
    <h1>Users</h1>

    <al-stack direction="row" gap="sm">
      <form method="get" action="/admin/user">
        <input type="search" name="q" value={model.q} aria-label="Search" />
        {for f in filters model.filters ->
          <al-select label={f.label}>
            <label>{f.label}
              <select name={f.name}>
                <option value="" selected={f.value == ""}>any</option>
                {for o in f.options -> <option value={o.value} selected={o.value == f.value}>{o.label}</option>}
              </select>
            </label>
          </al-select>}
        <input type="hidden" name="sort" value={model.sort} />
        <input type="hidden" name="dir" value={model.dir} />
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Search</al-button>
      </form>
      <al-button href={Admin.User.New {}}>New user</al-button>
    </al-stack>

    <p id="count">{if model.count == 1 then "1 row" else Text.fromInt model.count ++ " rows"}</p>

    <al-table>
      <table>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            -- @admin begin headers
            <th><span class="sr-only">Choose</span></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "email" (toggle model "email") 1}>Email</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "name" (toggle model "name") 1}>Name</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "created" (toggle model "created") 1}>Created</a></th>
            <th><a href={listAt model "role" (toggle model "role") 1}>Role</a></th>
            -- @admin end
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {for row in model.rows ->
            <tr>
              -- @admin begin cells
              <td><input type="checkbox" name="ids" form="bulk" value={row.id} aria-label="Choose this row" /></td>
              <td><a href={Admin.User.Show { id: row.id }}>{row.email}</a></td>
              <td>{row.name}</td>
              <td>{Time.format "Jan 2, 2006" row.created}</td>
              <td><al-badge>{match row.role { Member -> "Member", Admin -> "Admin" }}</al-badge></td>
              -- @admin end
            </tr>}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </al-table>

    <al-stack direction="row" gap="sm">
      <form id="bulk" method="get" action="/admin/user/bulk">
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Act on the chosen rows</al-button>
      </form>
      <form id="bulk-page" method="get" action="/admin/user/bulk">
        {for row in model.rows -> <input type="hidden" name="ids" value={row.id} />}
        <al-button type="submit" variant="secondary">Act on all rows on this page</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-stack>

    <al-pagination role="navigation" aria-label="Pages">
      {if model.page > 1 then <a slot="prev" href={listAt model model.sort model.dir (model.page - 1)} rel="prev">Previous</a> else <span slot="prev" aria-disabled="true">Previous</span>}
      <span>Page {Text.fromInt model.page} of {Text.fromInt model.pages}</span>
      {if model.page < model.pages then <a slot="next" href={listAt model model.sort model.dir (model.page + 1)} rel="next">Next</a> else <span slot="next" aria-disabled="true">Next</span>}
    </al-pagination>
  </Admin.Layout.Page>

-- @admin begin tests

msg Create form UserForm

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav

  -- @admin begin finds
  -- @admin end
  Create p -> {

    -- the admin never shows or writes a secret (passwordHash): a row starts without one
    let emailTaken <- Db.from User |> Db.where (User.email.eq p.form.email) |> Db.count
    if emailTaken > 0 then

      let id <- Db.insert User {

        name: p.form.name,
        role: p.form.role,

      Task.succeed (Redirect (Admin.User.Show { id: id }))

}

page "/admin/user/{id}" { id: User.UserId } requires user, role Admin

type Model = { row: User, labels: Labels }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model

module App

import User
import Layout

-- `role` is copied from the user's row at login (Auth.Login); the generated admin's pages
-- `requires user, role Admin` read it from here (book 06, "Rules"). Logging out makes it Member.
session { user: Maybe User.UserId, role: User.Role = Member }

login = Auth.Login

msg Logout

update : Msg -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg session = match msg {
  Logout p -> {
    let _ <- Session.put (\s -> { s | user: Nothing, role: Member })
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Auth.Login {}))
  },
}

error : Error -> Html Never
error err =
  <Layout.Page title="Error">
    <h1>Something went wrong</h1>
    <p>Please try again.</p>
  </Layout.Page>

notFound : Html Never
notFound =
  <Layout.Page title="Not found">
    <h1>Not found</h1>
  </Layout.Page>

-- Logging out from a page that `requires user` ends at the login page either way: a Rerender of
-- that page redirects there too. Only a test of `update` itself tells Redirect from Rerender.
test "Logout clears the user and goes to log in" = {
  let r <- Test.run (update Logout { user: Just (User.UserId "me"), role: Admin })
  Task.succeed ({ value: r.value, trace: r.trace } == { value: Ok (Redirect (Auth.Login {})), trace: ["Session.put"] })
}

-- Logging out also makes the role Member again: an Admin who logs out is no longer one.
test "Logout makes the role Member" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "", role: Admin }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me, role: Admin }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let out <- Test.click Logout
  Task.succeed ({ out: out.answer, role: out.session.role } == { out: Redirected (Auth.Login {}), role: Member })
}

module Auth.Login

import User
import Layout

-- Password checking is outside the language: a capability implemented in Go.
capability Password {
  verify : { email: Text.Email, password: Text } -> Task (Maybe User.UserId),
}

-- In a test, `Test.fake Password` puts this in the adapter's place: it accepts any user who has
-- a row, whatever the password, so a test can log in through the form below (book 10).
fake Password {
  verify args = {
    let found <- Db.from User |> Db.where (User.email.eq args.email) |> Db.first
    Task.succeed (Maybe.map (\u -> u.id) found)
  }
}

page "/login" { }

type Model = { }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = Query.succeed { }

form Credentials = {
  email: Text.Email,
  password: Text.Secret,
}

msg Submit form Credentials

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Submit p -> {
    let found <- Password.verify { email: p.form.email, password: p.form.password }
    match found {
      -- The session keeps the user and their role as the row has it now: a role changed later
      -- applies when they next log in.
      Just id -> {
        let found <- Db.get User id
        let role = Maybe.withDefault Member (Maybe.map (\u -> u.role) found)
        let _ <- Session.put (\s -> { s | user: Just id, role: role })
        Task.succeed (Redirect (Todos.Index {}))
      },
      Nothing -> Task.succeed (Reject "Email or password is incorrect."),
    }
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Layout.Page title="Log in">
    <h1>Log in</h1>
    <al-card>
      <form submit={Submit}>
        <Errors form />
        <al-input field="email" label="Email" />
        <al-input field="password" label="Password" />
        <al-button type="submit">Log in</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>
  </Layout.Page>

-- Logging in through the form, with the fake: an unknown email is rejected with the form's
-- message, and a known one stores the user in the session and goes to the to-do list.
test "an unknown email is rejected" = {
  let _ <- Test.fake Password
  let _ <- Test.get (Auth.Login {})
  let r <- Test.submit Credentials { email: Text.Email "nobody@example.com", password: Text.Secret "secret" }
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, user: r.session.user } == { answer: FormRejected [{ field: "", message: "Email or password is incorrect." }], user: Nothing })
}

test "logging in through the form" = {
  let _ <- Test.fake Password
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.get (Auth.Login {})
  let r <- Test.submit Credentials { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", password: Text.Secret "secret" }
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, user: r.session.user, title: Test.text "h1" r.doc } == { answer: Redirected (Todos.Index {}), user: Just me, title: Just "Todos" })
}

-- The session gets the role the user's row has: an Admin logs in as an Admin.
test "logging in copies the role from the user's row" = {
  let _ <- Test.fake Password
  let _ <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "admin@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Admin", passwordHash: "", role: Admin }
  let _ <- Test.get (Auth.Login {})
  let r <- Test.submit Credentials { email: Text.Email "admin@example.com", password: Text.Secret "secret" }
  Task.succeed (r.session.role == Admin)
}

test "a visitor is sent to log in, and can log out" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let visitor <- Test.open (Todos.Index {})
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let out <- Test.click App.Logout
  Task.succeed ({ visitor: visitor.answer, out: out.answer, user: out.session.user } == { visitor: Redirected (Auth.Login {}), out: Redirected (Auth.Login {}), user: Nothing })
}

module Profile

import Todo
import Layout
import User

page "/profile" { } requires user

type Model = {
  user: User,
  total: Int,
  done: Int,
}

-- The user's row is read again on every request: the session holds only the id. The counts use
-- the scoped `Db.mine Todo`, so they are only the signed-in user's todos (book 06, "Rules").
load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let found <- Db.get User session.user
  let total <- Db.mine Todo |> Db.count
  let done <- Db.mine Todo |> Db.where (Todo.done.eq True) |> Db.count
  match found {
    Just u -> Query.succeed { user: u, total: total, done: done },
    Nothing -> Query.notFound,
  }
}

form Rename = {
  name: Text.NonEmpty,
}

msg Save form Rename

-- `User` has no `@owner` column, so the write is unscoped; the row is the one `load` read for the
-- session's own user, so it can only ever be the signed-in user's.
update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Save p -> {
    let _ <- Db.update User model.user.id (\u -> { u | name: p.form.name })
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Profile {}))
  },
}

-- Logging out is the app-level message `App.Logout` (declared in App, not on the login page):
-- any page may send it, so the button posts it rather than declaring a second Logout here.
view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Layout.Page title="Profile">
    <h1>Profile</h1>

    <al-card>
      <dl>
        <dt>Name</dt>
        <dd id="name">{model.user.name}</dd>
        <dt>Email</dt>
        <dd id="email">{model.user.email}</dd>
        <dt>Todos</dt>
        <dd id="total">{Text.fromInt model.total}</dd>
        <dt>Done</dt>
        <dd id="done">{Text.fromInt model.done}</dd>
      </dl>
    </al-card>

    <al-card>
      <form submit={Save}>
        <al-input field="name" label="Name" value={model.user.name} />
        <al-button type="submit">Save</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>

    <p><a href={Todos.Index {}}>Back to the todos</a></p>

    <al-button variant="outline" click={App.Logout}>Log out</al-button>
  </Layout.Page>

test "load counts only the user's todos" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let other <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "other@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Other", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", done: True, due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Bread", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Eggs", done: True, due: Nothing, owner: other }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Jam", due: Nothing, owner: other }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let m <- load {} { user: me, role: Member }
  Task.succeed ({ name: m.user.name, total: m.total, done: m.done } == { name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", total: 2, done: 1 })
}

test "the page shows the name, the email and the counts" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", done: True, due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Profile {})
  Task.succeed ({
    name: Test.text "#name" page.doc,
    email: Test.text "#email" page.doc,
    total: Test.text "#total" page.doc,
    done: Test.text "#done" page.doc,
  } == {
    name: Just "Me",
    email: Just "me@example.com",
    total: Just "1",
    done: Just "1",
  })
}

test "renaming changes the name" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Profile {})
  let r <- Test.submit Rename { name: Text.NonEmpty "New Me" }
  let after <- Db.get User me
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, name: Maybe.map (\u -> u.name) after } == { answer: Redirected (Profile {}), name: Just (Text.NonEmpty "New Me") })
}

test "renaming to an empty name is refused" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Profile {})
  let r <- Test.submitRaw Rename [{ name: "name", value: "" }]
  let after <- Db.get User me
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, name: Maybe.map (\u -> u.name) after } == { answer: FormRejected [{ field: "name", message: "must not be empty" }], name: Just (Text.NonEmpty "Me") })
}

test "a visitor is sent to log in from the profile" = {
  let r <- Test.open (Profile {})
  Task.succeed (r.answer == Redirected (Auth.Login {}))
}

test "logging out from the profile" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Profile {})
  let out <- Test.click App.Logout
  Task.succeed ({ answer: out.answer, user: out.session.user } == { answer: Redirected (Auth.Login {}), user: Nothing })
}

--- file: app/Todo.alder ---
module Todo

import User

type TodoId = brand Text

type Filter = All | Active | Completed

-- `owner` is the table's `@owner`: `Db.mine Todo`, `Db.getMine`, `Db.updateMine`, `Db.deleteMine`
-- and `Db.insertMine` read and write only the signed-in user's todos (book 06, "Rules").
table Todo {
  id: TodoId @id,
  title: Text.NonEmpty,
  done: Bool = False,
  due: Maybe Date,
  owner: User.UserId @ref User @owner,
  created: Time @created,
}

matches : Filter -> Todo -> Bool
matches filter todo = match filter {
  All -> True,
  Active -> not todo.done,
  Completed -> todo.done,
}

filterLabel : Filter -> Text
filterLabel filter = match filter {
  All -> "All",
  Active -> "Active",
  Completed -> "Completed",
}

countOpen : List Todo -> Int
countOpen todos = todos |> List.filter (\t -> not t.done) |> List.length

test "countOpen ignores done todos" =
  countOpen [
    { id: TodoId "a", title: Text.NonEmpty "x", done: False, due: Nothing, owner: User.UserId "u", created: Time.epoch },
    { id: TodoId "b", title: Text.NonEmpty "y", done: True, due: Nothing, owner: User.UserId "u", created: Time.epoch },
    { id: TodoId "c", title: Text.NonEmpty "z", done: False, due: Nothing, owner: User.UserId "u", created: Time.epoch },
  ] == 2

test "Active keeps only open todos" =
  List.map (\t -> t.title) (List.filter (matches Active) [
    { id: TodoId "a", title: Text.NonEmpty "x", done: False, due: Nothing, owner: User.UserId "u", created: Time.epoch },
    { id: TodoId "b", title: Text.NonEmpty "y", done: True, due: Nothing, owner: User.UserId "u", created: Time.epoch },
  ]) == [Text.NonEmpty "x"]

test "each filter has its label" =
  List.map filterLabel [All, Active, Completed] == ["All", "Active", "Completed"]

-- `owner` is `@ref User` with the default rule, `@restrict`: a user who still has todos cannot
-- be deleted, and the todos stay.
test "a user with todos cannot be deleted" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let r <- Test.run (Db.delete User me)
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ deleted: Result.toMaybe r.value, todo: Maybe.map (\t -> t.title) after } == { deleted: Nothing, todo: Just (Text.NonEmpty "Milk") })
}

module Todos.Index

import Todo
import Layout
import User

page "/" { filter: Todo.Filter = All } requires user

type Model = {
  filter: Todo.Filter,
  todos: List Todo,
}

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let todos <-
    Db.mine Todo
      |> Db.orderBy Todo.created.desc
      |> Db.all
  Query.succeed { filter: params.filter, todos: List.filter (Todo.matches params.filter) todos }
}

form NewTodo = {
  title: Text.NonEmpty,
  due: Maybe Date,
}

msg Submit form NewTodo
msg Toggle { id: Todo.TodoId }
msg Delete { id: Todo.TodoId }

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Submit p -> {
    let _ <- Db.insertMine Todo { title: p.form.title, due: p.form.due }
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Todos.Index { filter: model.filter }))
  },
  -- A message's id comes from the request: anyone can post `Toggle` with another user's id.
  -- `Db.updateMine` and `Db.deleteMine` change the row only when it is the session's user's;
  -- any other id, like a missing one, is a 404 (book 06, "Rules").
  Toggle p -> {
    let _ <- Db.updateMine Todo p.id (\t -> { t | done: not t.done })
    Task.succeed Rerender
  },
  Delete p -> {
    let _ <- Db.deleteMine Todo p.id
    Task.succeed Rerender
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Layout.Page title="Todos">
    <h1>Todos</h1>

    <al-card>
      <form submit={Submit}>
        <al-input field="title" label="What needs doing?" />
        <al-input field="due" label="Due" />
        <al-button type="submit">Add</al-button>
      </form>
    </al-card>

    <nav>
      {for f in [All, Active, Completed] ->
        <a href={Todos.Index { filter: f }} aria-current={if model.filter == f then Just "page" else Nothing}>
          {Todo.filterLabel f}
        </a>}
    </nav>

    <ul id="todos">
      {for todo in model.todos -> <Item todo={todo} />}
    </ul>

    <p id="summary">{Text.fromInt (Todo.countOpen model.todos)} open</p>

    <p id="profile"><a href={Profile {}}>Profile</a></p>

    <al-button variant="outline" click={App.Logout}>Log out</al-button>
  </Layout.Page>

Item : { todo: Todo } -> Html Msg
Item props =
  <li class={if props.todo.done then "done" else ""}>
    <al-button variant="secondary" size="sm" click={Toggle { id: props.todo.id }}>{if props.todo.done then "Undo" else "Done"}</al-button>
    <a href={Todos.Show { id: props.todo.id }}>{props.todo.title}</a>
    {match props.todo.due {
      Just d -> <al-badge variant="outline" class="due">{Date.format "Jan 2" d}</al-badge>,
      Nothing -> Html.none,
    }}
    <al-button variant="ghost" size="sm" click={Delete { id: props.todo.id }}>Delete</al-button>
  </li>

test "Toggle flips done" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let r <- Test.run (update (Toggle { id: id }) { filter: All, todos: [] } { user: me, role: Member })
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  let done = Maybe.map (\t -> t.done) after
  Task.succeed ({ trace: r.trace, done: done } == { trace: ["Db.updateMine Todo"], done: Just True })
}

-- A stranger's own page lists none of my todos, but a message's id comes from the request.
-- Here my page is still open in the browser when a stranger logs in on it and presses my todo's
-- Toggle: `Db.updateMine` finds no todo of the stranger's with that id, so the answer is a 404
-- and nothing changes.
test "Toggle by another user is not found" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just (User.UserId "someone-else") }
  let r <- Test.click (Toggle { id: id })
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, done: Maybe.map (\t -> t.done) after } == { answer: PageMissing, done: Just False })
}

test "Delete by another user is not found" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just (User.UserId "someone-else") }
  let r <- Test.click (Delete { id: id })
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, todo: Maybe.map (\t -> t.title) after } == { answer: PageMissing, todo: Just (Text.NonEmpty "Milk") })
}

-- The same page through the browser: the test logs in, opens the page, and uses the form and
-- the buttons the page renders, as a user would (book 10, "Testing through the browser").
test "adding a todo through the page" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let added <- Test.submit NewTodo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing }
  let page <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  Task.succeed ({ answer: added.answer, todos: List.map (\t -> t.title) page.model.todos, summary: Test.text "#summary" page.doc } == { answer: Redirected (Todos.Index {}), todos: [Text.NonEmpty "Milk"], summary: Just "1 open" })
}

test "toggling a todo through the page" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let r <- Test.click (Toggle { id: id })
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, done: Test.has "li.done" r.doc, summary: Test.text "#summary" r.doc } == { answer: Rerendered, done: True, summary: Just "0 open" })
}

-- A stranger's page lists none of my todos, so it has no Toggle button to click for them; the
-- todo's own page is a 404 for the stranger.
test "a stranger cannot see my todo" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just (User.UserId "someone-else") }
  let page <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let show <- Test.open (Todos.Show { id: id })
  Task.succeed ({ items: Test.count "li" page.doc, show: show.answer } == { items: 0, show: PageMissing })
}

test "Delete removes the todo" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let r <- Test.run (update (Delete { id: id }) { filter: All, todos: [] } { user: me, role: Member })
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ value: r.value, todo: Maybe.map (\t -> t.title) after } == { value: Ok Rerender, todo: Nothing })
}

test "the newest todo is listed first" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "First", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Second", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  Task.succeed (Test.texts "li a" page.doc == ["Second", "First"])
}

-- A test may use the scoped operations itself: they act for the test's session, which
-- `Test.login` sets. `Db.mine Todo` is what Me sees, and not the other user's todo.
test "Db.mine is what Me sees" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let other <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "other@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Other", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Bread", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Eggs", due: Nothing, owner: other }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let r <- Test.run {
    let n <- Db.mine Todo |> Db.count
    Task.succeed n
  }
  Task.succeed ({ value: r.value, trace: r.trace } == { value: Ok 2, trace: ["Db.mine Todo", "Db.count Todo"] })
}

test "the list links to the profile" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let page <- Test.get (Todos.Index {})
  let profile <- Test.get (Profile {})
  Task.succeed ({ link: Test.text "#profile a" page.doc, title: Test.text "h1" profile.doc } == { link: Just "Profile", title: Just "Profile" })
}

module Todos.Show

import Todo
import Layout
import User

page "/todos/{id}" { id: Todo.TodoId } requires user

type Model = { todo: Todo }

load : Params -> Session -> Query Model
load params session = {
  let todo <- Db.getMine Todo params.id
  Query.succeed { todo: todo }
}

form EditTodo = {
  title: Text.NonEmpty,
  due: Maybe Date,
}

-- `Db.getMine` finds the todo only when it is the session's user's: anyone else's, like a missing
-- one, is a 404. The messages carry no id: the page's parameter names the todo, and every message
-- runs after this `load`, so `update` acts on `model.todo`. It still writes the scoped forms: they
-- cost nothing, and say what the page means (book 06, "Rules").
msg Save form EditTodo
msg Delete

update : Msg -> Model -> Session -> Task Nav
update msg model session = match msg {
  Save p -> {
    let _ <- Db.updateMine Todo model.todo.id (\t -> { t | title: p.form.title, due: p.form.due })
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Todos.Index {}))
  },
  Delete p -> {
    let _ <- Db.deleteMine Todo model.todo.id
    Task.succeed (Redirect (Todos.Index {}))
  },
}

view : Model -> Session -> Html Msg
view model session =
  <Layout.Page title={model.todo.title}>
    <h1>{model.todo.title}</h1>
    <al-card>
      <form submit={Save}>
        <al-input field="title" label="Title" value={model.todo.title} />
        <al-input field="due" label="Due" value={model.todo.due} />
        <al-button type="submit">Save</al-button>
      </form>
      <div slot="actions">
        <al-button variant="ghost" href={Todos.Index {}}>Back</al-button>
        <al-button variant="destructive" click={Delete}>Delete</al-button>
      </div>
    </al-card>
  </Layout.Page>

-- The page through the browser: a visitor is sent to log in; the owner saves the form and
-- deletes the todo with the buttons the page renders.
test "a visitor is sent to log in from a todo" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let visitor <- Test.open (Todos.Show { id: id })
  Task.succeed (visitor.answer == Redirected (Auth.Login {}))
}

test "saving changes the title and the due date" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Show { id: id })
  let r <- Test.submit EditTodo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Bread", due: Date.fromText "2026-10-12" }
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, title: Maybe.map (\t -> t.title) after, due: Maybe.andThen (\t -> t.due) after } == { answer: Redirected (Todos.Index {}), title: Just (Text.NonEmpty "Bread"), due: Date.fromText "2026-10-12" })
}

test "deleting from the todo's page" = {
  let me <- Db.insert User { email: Text.Email "me@example.com", name: Text.NonEmpty "Me", passwordHash: "" }
  let id <- Db.insert Todo { title: Text.NonEmpty "Milk", due: Nothing, owner: me }
  let _ <- Test.login { user: Just me }
  let _ <- Test.get (Todos.Show { id: id })
  let r <- Test.click Delete
  let after <- Db.get Todo id
  Task.succeed ({ answer: r.answer, todo: Maybe.map (\t -> t.title) after } == { answer: Redirected (Todos.Index {}), todo: Nothing })
}

module User

type UserId = brand Text

-- A Member keeps their own to-do list. An Admin can also open the admin that `alder new admin`
-- generated (app/Admin/, every page `requires user, role Admin`; book 15). The session holds
-- the role the user had when they logged in (App's `session`, set by Auth.Login).
type Role = Member | Admin

table User {
  id: UserId @id,
  email: Text.Email @unique,
  name: Text.NonEmpty,
  passwordHash: Text,
  created: Time @created,
  role: Role = Member,
}
